reviews.shade: Purito Seoul Wonder Releaf Centella Eye Cream Unscented 30ml
reviews.text: Estoy muy satisfecha con esta crema. Tiene una textura ligera que se absorbe rápidamente sin dejar sensación grasa. La piel alrededor de los ojos se siente mucho más hidratada, suave y calmada desde las primeras aplicaciones. Con el uso continuo, noté que la zona luce más fresca y descansada, y las líneas de expresión se ven un poco más suaves. Además, es muy delicada con la piel sensible y no me causó irritación. Sin duda, volvería a comprarla y la recomiendo a quienes buscan una crema para el contorno de ojos hidratante y calmante.
reviews.zh: 我對呢款面霜好滿意。質地輕盈，吸收好快，唔會留低油膩感。由頭幾次用開始，眼周皮膚就感覺水潤好多、柔滑好多、平靜好多。持續使用之後，我注意到個位睇落更清新、更精神，而且表情紋睇落都淡咗少少。另外，佢對敏感皮膚都好溫和，冇令我刺激。我一定會再買，亦會推薦畀想搵一款保濕又舒緩嘅眼霜嘅人。

reviews.shade: Purito Seoul Wonder Releaf Centella Eye Cream Unscented 30ml
reviews.text: This eye cream helped a lot my dryness around the eye area, apart from it it’s also hydrating so the lines of dehydration might disappear with the help of other hydrating products too. It doesn’t do anything else apart from it in terms of active ingredients but it’s totally fine, this makes it safe for almost everyone. I totally recommend it according to my experience.
reviews.zh: 呢款眼霜幫我改善咗眼周嘅乾燥問題好多。除此之外，佢都有保濕效果，所以缺水紋都可能會同其他保濕產品一齊幫手而淡化。除咗呢啲之外，佢喺活性成分方面冇其他功效，不過都完全冇問題，所以幾乎人人都可以安心用。根據我嘅經驗，我十分推薦。

reviews.shade: Purito Seoul Wonder Releaf Centella Eye Cream Unscented 30ml
reviews.text: I love this eye cream I have purchased this 3 times now is definitely a favourite. Great for sensitive eyes has helped my under eyes looks so much more refreshed and hydrated and wears amazing under makeup
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢款眼霜，而家已經買咗三次，絕對係我最愛。適合敏感眼周，令我眼底睇落精神好多、水潤好多，而且化妝底下嘅效果都好好。

reviews.shade: Purito Seoul Wonder Releaf Centella Eye Cream Unscented 30ml
reviews.text:
홈페이지 배송 상태랑 실제 배송 상황도 전혀 맞지 않았음. 도착 예정이라더니 갑자기 예고 없이 아침 일찍 페덱스 방문. 당연히 못 받아서 놓쳤더니, 아무 안내도 없이 두 시간 거리 지점으로 직접 찾으러 오라고 함.
게다가 세금 42불이 나온다는 안내는 단 한 번도 없었음. 미리 고지조차 없이 현장에서 바로 결제 요구.
결국 전철 타고 왕복하면서 시간만 약 3시간 날리고, 추가 비용까지 내고 겨우 수령함. 배송은 엉망이고, 안내는 부실하고, 비용은 숨겨져 있는 수준.
올리브영 글로벌 배송은 절대 추천 안 함. 진짜 스트레스만 받는 경험.
reviews.zh:
網站嘅配送狀態同實際配送情況完全唔符。話預計到達，但係突然冇預告，一朝早就有 FedEx 上門。當然冇人收，錯過咗之後，佢哋冇任何通知，就叫我親自去兩個鐘車程嘅分店攞。
而且，我從來冇收到過要畀 42 蚊稅款嘅通知。冇任何事先通知，就即場要求付款。
結果我要坐地鐵來回，白白浪費咗大約 3 個鐘，仲要再付額外費用，先好不容易攞到貨。配送亂晒，通知唔足，費用又隱藏住，就係咁嘅水平。
我絕對唔推薦 Olive Young 全球配送。真係淨係畀人壓力嘅體驗。

reviews.shade: Purito Seoul Wonder Releaf Centella Eye Cream Unscented 30ml
reviews.text: This eye cream is very gentle and lightweight. It absorbs quickly and helps soothe and hydrate the under-eye area without irritation. I also love that it's unscented, making it perfect for sensitive skin. My under-eyes feel smoother and more refreshed.
reviews.zh: 呢款眼霜好溫和、質地輕盈。吸收好快，有助舒緩同保濕眼下嘅位置，唔會刺激。我仲好鍾意佢冇任何香味，所以好啱敏感肌。我嘅眼下感覺更加滑、更加清爽。

reviews.shade: Purito Seoul Wonder Releaf Centella Eye Cream Unscented 30ml
reviews.text: Rosacea girlies - you probably need this one! I get insane irritation around my eyes with any kind of eye cream. This one feels super soothing and really comfortable. Doesn’t feel heavy on the skin, absorbs quickly. Haven’t tried it under makeup yet but nothing indicates that it will cause any trouble)
reviews.zh: 玫瑰痤瘡（Rosacea）嘅姊妹，你哋可能好需要呢款！我用咩眼霜，眼周都會好誇張咁刺激。呢款感覺超舒緩，而且好舒服。搽落皮膚唔會覺得厚重，吸收好快。我未試過化妝底下用，但係冇任何跡象顯示會有咩問題)

reviews.shade: Purito Seoul Wonder Releaf Centella Eye Cream Unscented 30ml
reviews.text:
Es bastante bueno, me lo pongo todas las noches y me humecta bastante debajo de los ojos, mis ojeras, en el mes que llevo usándolo, se han aclarado considerablemente.
Eso si tiene un olor un poco fuerte que a veces hace me hace lagrimear y tiene un ardor leve .
Tarda en absorbese.
reviews.zh:
幾好用，我每晚都搽，眼下保濕效果都好足，我嘅黑眼圈，用咗一個月，明顯淡咗好多。
不過佢嘅味道有少少濃，有時會令我流眼淚，搽落有啲輕微灼熱感。
吸收要耐啲。

reviews.shade: Purito Seoul Wonder Releaf Centella Eye Cream Unscented 30ml
reviews.text: Amazing product! Clear and light; very easy to apply. Absorbs quickly and doesn't irritate the skin at all. It also reduces inflammation throughout the day and does not have any odour. The packaging is cute and practical. Would repurchase anytime!
reviews.zh: 好正嘅產品！清透輕盈，好易搽。吸收好快，完全唔刺激皮膚。亦可以全日減輕發炎。而且冇任何異味。包裝可愛又實用。隨時都會再買！

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
